task: V15 Q1 existence map of the MN B = 0 set

derivation: y=0: P1=0, P2=-1/2, Sa=-1+x/R-x/(2R^3) = -Sb, so a=-b identically (alpha<0 => a>0>b).
With s = arcoth x (x/R = cosh s, R = 1/sinh s) and -ln|alpha| = artanh(kappa):
beta (cosh s - 1)^2 (cosh s + 2) = s + artanh(kappa),  beta = q/kappa^3, kappa = sqrt(1-chi^2).
Equivalently 4 beta sinh^4(s/2)(cosh s+2) = s + artanh(kappa); in x: beta (x/R-1)^2 (x/R+2) = arcoth x + artanh kappa.
Uniqueness: beta = H(s) := (s+T)/G(s), T = artanh kappa > 0. H decreases strictly: (s+T) G'/G >= s G'/G = 2 s coth(s/2) + s sinh s/(cosh s+2) > 4 > 1. H -> inf (s->0, x->inf), H -> 0 (s->inf, x->1+).
=> exactly one root x_s > 1 for every q > 0 and every chi in (0,1); none for q <= 0 (G > 0, s+T > 0).
R = 1/2 <=> x = sqrt5/2 <=> s = asinh 2, G = 2(1+sqrt5): root has R < 1/2 iff q < q*(chi) = kappa^3 [asinh 2 + artanh kappa] / (2(1+sqrt5)).
Off equator: with a = p > 0, b = -r < 0, B = 0 <=> pr = (x+1)/(x-1) and (1+y)p = (1-y)r <=> E1: beta S = arcoth x + artanh kappa,  E2: beta D = artanh y, with S = Sb - Sa, D = Sb + Sa.

Hence every B=0 point (x,y), y != 0, fixes beta = artanh(y)/D and T = beta S - arcoth x uniquely; it is a zero for a physical chi iff T > 0 (chi = sech T, q = beta tanh^3 T). B = 0 implies A = 0 identically (shown above).

edges (analytic): D->0+ (y^2<3/5, x^2-1 = 2y^4/(3-5y^2)): S < 0 there (checked at 30 dig, 7 pts), beta -> +inf, T -> -inf.
R->0 (x->1, y->0) with D>0: beta S stays bounded or -> -inf while -arcoth x -> -inf.
x->1 at fixed y>0: D -> -2 < 0 (not in the D>0 region).
